verdict.rationale: Epic's license terms explicitly grant 'Access to the source code' plus 'all platforms & features,' and the C++ programming docs describe compiling engine/gameplay class changes directly in Visual Studio/XCode, which together substantiate reading and modifying full engine source when needed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on account of actually patching core engine internals (not just extending via subclasses), and the probe notes source access is gated behind an EULA-linked GitHub account rather than being openly browsable, which adds friction not addressed in the docs.
